svg.title: Agents Dashboard — production architecture on Azure
svg.desc: Developer-run agents connect to Azure API Management, which routes MCP and REST to a FastAPI container. A separate React container serves the web dashboard. Company SSO uses Microsoft Entra ID, secrets use Azure Key Vault, and the primary database is Databricks Lakebase PostgreSQL with a configurable PostgreSQL fallback. Provider, Figma, Jira and authorized GitHub connections are shown separately.
svg.text: Production deployment target on Azure · developer-run agents · personas and external services
Drives the run, stage by stage
Separate backend and web dashboard containers
Model calls from the local Claude Code / Codex client
Figma designs · Claude Code / Codex calls Figma MCP using client OAuth
git push (HTTPS / SSH) · gh pr create fallback · developer authorization required
PR API · saved token · developer authorization
Requirement intake: developer prompt → local Claude Code/Codex → start_run + get_ticket → backend returns requirements and workflow instructions.
First run: local client writes AGENTS.md and saves it through the backend. MCP replies carry prompts and approvals; approval polling is every 20 seconds.
Production target: SSO, containers and Azure services are deployment requirements. PostgreSQL fallback is selected via DATABASE_URL; no automatic failover is implied.
